[PREFERENCE] User is looking for tips on how to properly clean and maintain their vintage cameras.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided specific lens cleaning tips, including using a soft, dry lens cloth and a lens cleaning solution.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested checking and cleaning the battery compartment and lubricating the film advance for mechanical maintenance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended storing the Contax T2 in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight.  
[PREFERENCE] User is considering displaying their vinyl records alongside their cameras.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided suggestions for displaying vinyl records in a visually appealing way while protecting them from direct sunlight and dust.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended using glass-front display cases with UV-filtering glass for cameras and vinyl records.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested using floating shelves or wall-mounted shelves for both cameras and vinyl records.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised using soft, indirect lighting to highlight the display and avoid direct sunlight.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested grouping similar cameras and records together for a cohesive look.
